notes: DE&I KPIs/targets (women in management, target nationalities) expired at end of 2025 and IROs were amended to focus on equal treatment; recorded as past (E10) and not scored. A Culture and Inclusion team was established in 2025. The LET humanitarian relief (logistics hub in Amman, food transport in South Sudan) was not recorded because the source sentence is broken by a PDF hyphenation. The EV Deployment Guideline for SME truckers (E6) is 'to be openly shared'. It was not counted for Entrepreneurship because it addresses fleet energy transition, not barriers to starting or growing a business. The GIVO start-up partnership is a community/environment partnership, not an enabling programme. 165+ nationalities is demographics only. E3 quote ends at the dash before a hyphenated line break; the clause is a complete thought.
